name: aero-openfoam
description: The drag area of a body in an open stream, by ESI OpenFOAM v2606 (snappyHexMesh, simpleFoam, k-omega SST) behind guards: case, flow, regime, domain, mesh, convergence.
settles: drag of a vehicle in still air
lenses: a box too small for the wake
a mesh the mesher gave up on
convergence that is a limit cycle
a drag area for the wrong question
against something that is not this solver
origin: written for nopekit (GitHub issue #15, the motorBike design) against ESI OpenFOAM v2606 and Open MPI 4.1.6, run as outside tools. Every log line, output path and failure mode the gates rely on was measured on v2606 in P0 (2026-10-23); its dictionary reader and tool runner are cfd-openfoam's, copied byte for byte under a drift test.
